# Sim.Faciem.InternalEditor -- Coding Conventions

## Assembly & Namespace
- Assembly: `Sim.Faciem.InternalEditor`, editor-only (NET 4.6)
- Namespace: `Plugins.Sim.Faciem.Editor`
- Depends on: `Sim.Faciem` (core), `Sim.Faciem.Editor`, Addressables, R3, Unity Editor APIs

## Addressables Integration
- `FaciemSetup` uses `[InitializeOnLoadMethod]` to ensure the `FaciemAddressables.ViewId` label exists on startup.
- Addressable helpers (`AddressableExtensions`, `AddressableHelper`) are `internal static` -- do not expose them publicly.
- Never hard-code Addressable label strings -- always reference constants from `FaciemAddressables`.

## ViewId & RegionName Code Generation
- `ViewIdCodeGenerator` and `RegionNameCodeGenerator` write `.cs` files via `File.WriteAllText` to a user-selected folder.
- Always call `AssetDatabase.Refresh()` after writing generated files.
- Generated files must have an `// <auto-generated>` header including the generator name and UTC timestamp.
- `ViewIdAssetEditor` is a `[CustomEditor(typeof(ViewIdAsset))]` inspector -- keep it focused on display and action buttons; avoid heavy layout.

## Design-Time Data Context Wizard
- `DesignTimeDataContextWizard` is an `EditorWindow` opened via `Assets/Create/Faciem/Design-Time Data Context`.
- Discover `DesignTimeDataContext` subtypes via `AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies()` reflection at editor startup in `CreateGUI()`.
- Use `Observable.FromEvent` + R3 for reacting to control changes inside `CreateGUI()`.
- After creating an asset: call `AssetDatabase.CreateAsset`, then `AssetDatabase.SaveAssets()`.

## Menu Item Conventions
- `Assets/Create/Faciem/...` for wizard and creation actions.
- `Tools/Sim.Faciem/...` for utility and maintenance actions.

## General Rules
- Use `[InitializeOnLoadMethod]` for startup-only initialization; use `[InitializeOnLoad]` + static constructor only when a static constructor body is needed.
- Avoid mutable static state -- use `SessionState` for session-scoped values.
- Use `EditorUtility.DisplayProgressBar` / `ClearProgressBar` for long-running code generation.

## Do Not
- Do not add runtime (non-editor) code to this assembly.
- Do not reference `Sim.Faciem.Material.Editor` from this assembly.
- Do not use `AssetDatabase.LoadAllAssetsAtPath` in hot paths -- cache results.
